development.selection: Joint A/B final validation regret then q MAE across prelisted mixed recipes; no test access. Main always fixed final200, no earliest-tie deployment.

training.selection: fixed-final-200; common LR selected only by G2 train/validation diagnosis; same minibatch order for all four methods
